author: (Parr, 1946)

note.en: A grenadier of the deep slope; known here from a 1238 m museum sample taken off the southern Caribbean coast.
note.es: Un granadero de la pendiente profunda; aquí se conoce por una muestra de museo a 1238 m frente a la costa caribeña sur.

evidence: GBIF: 3 records (1 preserved specimen set) from a 1238 m sample in the region, Smithsonian NMNH, 2011
